name: Margaret Higgins
household: Partner, widowed brother living in the guest wing
psychographics: Values independence and knowing exactly where every penny goes. Believes in 'waste not, want not' and finds comfort in routine.
current_solutions: Uses a paper list and her old flip phone to call the local IGA. Her brother does the bulk shopping on Saturdays.
frustration: Last month, she drove 45 minutes to the Walmart Supercenter at 8:00 AM on a Tuesday only to find the milk was expired and the produce section was picked clean. She had to turn around and drive home without buying anything useful.
decision_style: Buys in bulk only when the pantry is empty; otherwise, she makes do with what she has to avoid another long trip.
voice: Soft-spoken but firm, speaks in complete sentences about costs and savings, rarely uses slang, prefers face-to-face conversation.
